We cannot turn from them to the Syrians while Assad's troops are using howitzers and sniper rifles against his people. This is the time not for diplomatic engagement with Assad, but for diplomacy aimed at quarantining his
regime and helping bring it down. The White House should dismiss any remaining dreams of a "peace process" with Syria to substitute for the Palestinian version and face facts: There will be no peace with the butcher who rules Syria today.

Elliott Abrams, senior fellow for Middle Eastern studies at the

Council on Foreign Relations, was a deputy national security adviser in the George W. Bush administration.
